# 일비 퍼퓨머리 하우스 | ILLVII Perfumery House

Official website: https://perfumery.kr/
Guide hub: https://perfumery.kr/guide/
Company: 제로톤 주식회사 / ZEROTONE INC.
Brand: 일비 퍼퓨머리 하우스 / ILLVII Perfumery House
Location: Seoul, Republic of Korea
Address: 서울특별시 도봉구 방학로 171-5
Since: 2014
Contact: business@perfumery.kr

## Core facts
- Small-batch perfume OEM / ODM manufacturing in Seoul, Korea
- MOQ: consultation from 50 units depending on product specification and packaging conditions
- Fragrance development, mixing, filling, labeling
- Brand perfume, goods perfume, PB product consultation
- Fragrance development: KRW 200,000 for 1 fragrance; sample 1 time and revision 1 time included
- Production labor, fragrance/material cost, containers, labels and packaging are quoted separately
